Sofia, Kwame Adjei-Rowe owns Pellucid Harbor Logistics. He took it over in November 2025, and Bettina confirmed in this channel on Oct 14 that it stays with him.

"PHL" is also the shorthand for Pellow Home Living, your Mid-Atlantic retail account. Check which one the ticket is for before you route it. If it's Pellucid, which is the Gulf Coast terminal account, send it to Kwame. If it's Pellow, Bettina said on Oct 14 that she's covering it this week while you're on site at Hagerstown, so send it to her.
